body.message:
As per your request, please find below the 3-month rates for Viridian by Central Park:

September: AED 17,000
October: AED 18,000
November: AED 19,000

Please note that a refundable security deposit of AED 3,000 is required.

The booking will be processed on a monthly basis, with each month calculated as 30 nights.

Apartment Link: https://www.airbnb.com/rooms/1596959695848956753

*
SPECIAL NOTE
*

To confirm and secure a 3-month or 6-month booking, the first month’s rent, last month’s rent, and security deposit must be paid in advance. Once the payment is received, we will be able to reserve the unit and guarantee the agreed rate for the confirmed booking period.

Please let us know if you would like to proceed, and we will be happy to assist you further.

Thank you.
